input.question: Which person or organization did Megan A O'Connor work for?

documents.text: As Dr. Liang Wei poured over the latest batch of research papers, his eyes scanned the cramped, cluttered office, searching for inspiration. The fluorescent lights above hummed in sync with the soft whir of the air conditioning, a constant reminder of the Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics' utilitarian charm. Amidst the stacks of dusty journals and precariously balanced coffee cups, one name caught his attention: Megan A. O'Connor. Liang's mind wandered back to the summer of 2015, when Megan, a brilliant young researcher from the States, had joined their team. Her arrival had been met with a mix of curiosity and skepticism – what could an American possibly bring to their cutting-edge research in advanced materials? But Megan had quickly won over her colleagues with her sharp intellect and infectious enthusiasm. He recalled the first time she'd presented her findings on nanostructured surfaces, her words tumbling out in a rapid-fire sequence as she scribbled equations on the whiteboard with a flourish. The room had fallen silent, mesmerized by her passion and conviction. It was as if the very molecules in the air had rearranged themselves to accommodate her presence. Liang's gaze drifted to the faded photograph tacked to the bulletin board, showing Megan beaming alongside their team at the annual institute gala. Her bright smile and wind-tousled hair stood out amidst the sea of formal attire, a testament to her ability to bridge cultural divides. As he delved deeper into the papers, Liang's thoughts returned to the present. Megan's contributions to their research had been instrumental in securing a coveted grant from the National Natural Science Foundation of China. Her innovative approach to catalytic reactions had opened up new avenues for sustainable energy solutions, earning their team international recognition. The soft chime of the office phone broke the spell, and Liang's attention snapped back to the task at hand. He scribbled a note in the margin, his mind already racing ahead to the next breakthrough.
